verses.text: Yahweh told Joshua, ‘Don’t be scared or lose heart. Take all the warriors, get up, and go after Ai. Look—I’ve put Ai’s king, his people, his city, and his land in your hands. 🛡️
‘Handle Ai and its king the way you handled Jericho and its king, except this time you can keep the goods and livestock. Set an ambush behind the city.’ 🎯
So Joshua and all the warriors got moving toward Ai. He picked 30,000 battle-ready men and sent them out at night. 🌙
He told them, ‘Listen up: set the ambush behind the city. Don’t get too far away. Stay ready. 🤫
‘Me and everyone with me will approach the city. When they come out to fight us like last time, we’ll act beaten and run. 🏃
‘They’ll chase us away from the city, thinking, “They’re running like before.” That’s when we keep drawing them out. 🏃
‘Then you pop up from the ambush and take the city. Yahweh your God is handing it to you. ⚔️
‘Once you’ve taken the city, set it on fire, just as Yahweh said. That’s the order—I’ve told you.’ 🔥
Joshua sent the ambush crew out. They went and set up between Bethel and Ai, west of Ai, while Joshua stayed with the people that night. 🌙
Joshua got up early, gathered the people, and headed toward Ai with Israel’s elders leading the way. 🌅
The whole crew, including the warriors with him, went up, came close to the city, and camped north of Ai. A valley lay between them and the city. 🏕️
Joshua took about 5,000 men and posted them in an ambush between Bethel and Ai, west of the city. 🛡️
So they set the troops north of the city and the ambush west of it. That night Joshua went down into the middle of the valley. 🌙
When Ai’s king spotted them, he and all his people hurried out early to fight Israel at the appointed time, in front of the Arabah. He had no idea an ambush was waiting behind the city. ⚔️
Joshua and all Israel acted like they were losing and took off toward the wilderness. 🏃
Everyone in Ai was called up to chase them. They went after Joshua and got pulled farther and farther from the city. 🏃
Not one man stayed behind in Ai or Bethel; everybody ran out after Israel. The city was left wide open while they chased Israel. 🏙️
Yahweh told Joshua, ‘Stretch the javelin in your hand toward Ai. I’m handing the city to you.’ Joshua stretched his javelin toward it. 🗡️
The ambush crew jumped up from their spot and rushed the city as soon as Joshua stretched out his hand. They took it fast and set it on fire. 🔥

When Ai’s men looked back, smoke was climbing from the city up to heaven. They couldn’t run this way or that. The people who had fled toward the wilderness turned around and came after their pursuers. 🌫️
Joshua and all Israel saw the ambush had taken the city and smoke was rising. They turned back and struck down Ai’s men. ⚔️
The others came out of the city against them, so Israel’s forces had them in the middle—some on one side, some on the other. They struck them down; nobody got away or escaped. 🛡️
They captured Ai’s king alive and brought him to Joshua. ⛓️
After Israel had finished killing the people they chased in the fields and wilderness, and everyone had fallen by the sword, all Israel returned to Ai and struck it with the sword too. ⚔️
That day, 12,000 people fell—men and women, every person from Ai. ⚠️
Joshua kept his hand stretched out, holding the javelin, until every person living in Ai had been destroyed. 🗡️
Israel kept only the city’s livestock and goods for themselves, just as Yahweh had told Joshua. 🐑
Joshua burned Ai and left it a heap of ruins, still deserted to this day. 🔥
He hanged Ai’s king on a tree until evening. At sunset Joshua gave the order; they took the body down, threw it at the city gate, and piled a huge heap of stones over it. It’s still there today. ⚖️
Then Joshua built an altar to Yahweh, Israel’s God, on Mount Ebal, 🛕

just as Moses, Yahweh’s servant, had commanded Israel and as written in Moses’ law book: an altar of uncut stones, with no iron tool used on them. They offered burnt offerings to Yahweh and sacrificed peace offerings there. 🪨
Joshua copied Moses’ law onto the stones, right there in front of all Israel. 📜

All Israel stood on both sides of the ark, with elders, officers, and judges, before the Levitical priests carrying Yahweh’s covenant ark. Foreigners and native-born people were there too: half faced Mount Gerizim, half Mount Ebal, just as Moses, Yahweh’s servant, had first commanded so Israel could be blessed. 👥
Afterward Joshua read every word of the law—the blessings and the curses—just as they’re written in the law book. 📖
Joshua didn’t skip a single word Moses had commanded. He read it in front of the whole assembly of Israel: the women, the children, and the foreigners living among them too. 📜
